reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest')). Although there is a regex validation gate (line 21: param.matches(pat)), the pattern is retrieved from deploy-time configuration and its exact content is unknown. The sink at line 22 writes param directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. User-controlled input reaches the response sink without proper sanitization/encoding, creating XSS vulnerability. The regex gate does not constitute reliable mitigation since it depends on external configuration and does not perform HTML entity encoding.

evidence.note: Sink: response.getWriter().println(param) outputs user input without HTML encoding
